resultSummary: From the MetzDowd message timestamp 2008-10-31T18:10:00Z to Bitcoin block 0 timestamp 2009-01-03T18:15:05Z is 64 days, 0 hours, 5 minutes and 5 seconds. From the same message timestamp to the 2009-01-13T00:00:00Z SourceForge reference is 73 days, 5 hours and 50 minutes. These are temporal intervals only and provide no real-world identity inference.
method: Wolfram Language DateDifference over UTC-normalized DateObject values. Bitcoin block 0 timestamp is obtained from BlockchainBlockData[0, "Timestamp", BlockchainBase -> "Bitcoin"].
reproducibleInput: mail = DateObject[{2008,10,31,18,10,0}, "Instant", "Gregorian", 0]; genesis = BlockchainBlockData[0, "Timestamp", BlockchainBase -> "Bitcoin"]; sf = DateObject[{2009,1,13,0,0,0}, "Instant", "Gregorian", 0]; {DateDifference[mail, genesis, {"Days","Hours","Minutes","Seconds"}], DateDifference[mail, sf, {"Days","Hours","Minutes","Seconds"}]}
truthBoundary: Temporal evidence only. The archived sender attribution is not a cryptographic or real-world identity proof.
